description: Mark a phase complete. Requires the phase output's validation to be PASS or PASS WITH GAPS and applies the phase handoff at scratch/handoffs/<phase>.yaml. Atomically updates status.yaml under a file lock, appends one THREAD_LOG.md entry, and writes the phase's closeout: the handoff's closeout_content (plus its decisions) overwrites the canonical <date>-<phase>.md when supplied; otherwise a stub is copied from the template only if no closeout exists yet. If phase is omitted, completes the next eligible phase.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the target repository.

name: codecarto_complete
